title: Cipher and Parish
author: F. M. Marchetti
blurb: Quentin Pemberton, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
